description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView used for displaying log data received via the LogNode interface within an Android application. It formats log messages, including log level, tag, message, and exceptions, and displays them in the UI, supporting chaining with other LogNode implementations.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display formatted log messages on the UI. It supports chaining to other LogNode objects and handles formatting of log level, tags, messages, and exceptions, updating the UI thread safely.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log message with priority, tag, message, and exception details, then updates the LogView UI component. Also propagates the log message to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
